join_order.notes: Use sub_adsh_lookup index for O(1) sub row lookup; pre-build adsh bitset from qualifying sub rows
Hash map keyed by (adsh_code, tag_code) -> max double value; only adsh codes with fy=2022 included

filters.predicate: uom = :uom_eq AND value IS NOT NULL

filters.notes: Applied during both passes to restrict to adsh codes with fy=2022

optimization_pushdown.description: Push sub.fy filter into both num passes: only compute max and match for adsh codes where sub.fy=2022. Reduces hash map from ~1M groups to ~75K groups and cuts pass2 matching work proportionally.
optimization_pushdown.correctness: The subquery max is per (adsh,tag). Since output requires s.fy=2022, we only need max values for qualifying adsh codes. The max over a restricted adsh set equals the global max restricted to that adsh, so results are identical.

data_structures.max_value_map: compact_hash_map<uint64_t, double>(pre_sized=100000) — key = (adsh_code << 32 | tag_code), value = max double

phase0_setup.description: Load dictionaries and build qualifying adsh bitset
steps: Load uom.dict, find code for :uom_eq parameter
Load tag.dict and name.dict for final output decode
Scan sub: for each row where fy == :fy_eq, set bit in adsh_bitset using sub.adsh[row]
Also build array: qualifying_sub_name[adsh_code] = sub.name[row] for output

phase1_build_max_map.description: Parallel scan of num to build (adsh,tag)->max(value) map for qualifying adsh codes
phase1_build_max_map.filter_chain: uom == uom_code AND value_null == 0 AND adsh_bitset[adsh_code]
phase1_build_max_map.action: Insert/update max_value in hash map keyed by composite key (adsh_code, tag_code)

phase2_match_and_collect.description: Parallel scan of num to find rows matching max value, collect results
phase2_match_and_collect.filter_chain: uom == uom_code AND value_null == 0 AND adsh_bitset[adsh_code] AND value == max_map[key]
phase2_match_and_collect.action: Collect (value, name_code, tag_code) into per-thread result vector

phase3_topk_sort.action: std::partial_sort on merged results, compare by (value DESC, name_string ASC, tag_string ASC)
phase3_topk_sort.string_compare: Decode name_code and tag_code via dictionaries for comparison, or use dictionary-order if lexicographically consistent

parallelism.notes: 16 threads: each thread-local hash map ~75K entries × 16B ≈ 1.2MB, total ~19MB fits in 44MB L3. Both passes use same morsel partitioning.

indexes.purpose: O(1) lookup of sub row_id by adsh_code during phase0 (building name lookup array)

mmap_strategy.advice: MADV_SEQUENTIAL for full-column scans in pass1 and pass2
mmap_strategy.raii_scope: Declare mmap resources before timer scope to exclude munmap TLB shootdown cost

output.decode: Use name.dict and tag.dict to convert codes to strings for output and string-order comparison

uom_eq.usage: dictionary lookup to find uom code

uom_eq_2.usage: same as uom_eq, used in subquery — identical filter
